description: F0-D T7: vacuum gaps along the cell vectors (facet/analysis/vacuum.py, web/js/core/vacuum.js): the F0-D scenarios at three positions along c, ties, thresholds, frames, cuts and their hint, exclude, the surface normal rules, the hints, unwrapping, wrap_fractional, contiguous shifts and the CONTCAR fixture.
